greedy_rule: Start with maximum individual reward; then maximize exact selection-set voting correct count after appending one unused expert. Break ties by higher individual reward, then ascending SHA256(committee-tie-v1:<seed>:<candidate_id>). Continue even if marginal accuracy is zero or negative. No swaps or restarts.
standard_tie_rule: Descending individual selection reward, then SHA256(rank-tie-v1:<candidate_id>), as in the existing reference. Committee order is rank order.
vote_rule: Pinned RandOpt answer extraction; ignore empty answers; Counter.most_common(1) insertion-order ties following committee construction order; score formatted #### answer with pinned reward > 0.
random_control_rule: Match the primary greedy sequence's exact individual correct-count at every position. For each correct-count group, permute eligible IDs with numpy.default_rng(seed) starting from ID-sorted candidates; consume without replacement. Every prefix therefore has exactly the same individual-score multiset. No error-disagreement optimization; report actual diversity and singleton constraints.
optional_diversity_variant: Omitted to keep one proposed selector plus exact-quality random controls; no lambda search.

fresh_dataset.rule: First 300 rows starting at official index 40 whose formatted prompt is absent from all pre-existing examples JSONL inputs; compare exact prompt text, no outcome filtering. Persist exact indices and input hashes before GPU execution.

candidate_order: Round robin over populations; within population sort selected union by candidate_id. No order depends on held-out outputs.
completion_rule: Every selected union candidate must complete all fresh prompts and pass fingerprint/restoration controls. Incomplete or invalid execution is not a scientific NO; preserve it and repair only operational failures, with no new selector experiment.
freeze_rule: Commit this protocol, frozen fresh inputs, offline committee-lock.json and union.json before GPU evaluation. Worker checks committed bytes and expected state fingerprint BEFORE each candidate generation.

gate.rule: GO if at least one identical comparison passes on BOTH validation A and B for the predeclared primary tie seed 0. Development does not count. Diagnostic tie seeds and random controls cannot be substituted. Otherwise NO-GO. No threshold changes.
gate.overfitting_rule: Selection-set gains without a held-out accuracy or qualifying efficiency win are overfitting and a NO. Report every selection gain -> held-out gain.
gate.incrementality_check: Also report whether standard small-K committees already meet the same efficiency threshold; the literal gate alone must not be misrepresented as incremental benefit when they do. Random controls and tie-seed sensitivity are required diagnostics, not alternative qualifying policies.

uncertainty: Report paired per-question improvements/regressions and deterministic question-bootstrap 95% intervals (seed 20261003, 10000 replicates); intervals are descriptive and do not alter the frozen point-estimate gate. Shared prompts/populations and paired sigmas are dependent.
cost_scope: Committee deployment: K experts, K full-benchmark generation RPCs, K times fresh-prompt-count request sequences, exact sum of saved generated tokens. Union collection and controls counted separately. Expert-pass ratios are exact logical reductions, not wall-clock speedups.
stop_rule: At most offline selection and one selected-union GPU experiment; stop after the GO/NO-GO report. No novel selector, kernel, or further threshold tuning.
